_about: Default weekly exercise plan from 'Astronaut Exercise Program' (15 Nov 2026), based on the ISS Sprint protocol (English et al. 2020) and its Supplementary Tables 3 and 4 (downloaded 15 Nov 2026): interval rest times, exercises of each resistance day, 4 x 12 / 4 x 8 / 4 x 6. Day layout is the document's arrangement, not a published NASA calendar. Loads are the median ISS session loads (npj Microgravity 2023: squat 181 lb, deadlift 192 lb, heel raise 239 lb, bench press 122 lb) converted to kg; bench press and row are the document's proposal. Each crew member's plan can be edited on the Physical screen.
